title: December, 2015 · the dock (earlier that day)
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Before the garage: Christmas Eve on Gully's dock. Maria, two kids, Gully, Wood, the pup. Chloe arrives tomorrow; nobody knows yet.

panels.composition: Gully's dock, Christmas Eve, string lights. MARIA in the lawn chair with the toddler. GULLY's girl, five, running the dock. WOOD on the steps. BARNABY II chasing the girl.

balloons.text: Tomorrow. Alone. I didn't tell you.
